strings.name: Lee Jae-yong
strings.summary: After studies in Seoul, Japan and the US, Lee entered Samsung and took on global customers and group management, becoming chairman in 2022. He participated in semiconductor and device investments amid succession controversies. A 2021 bribery retrial brought imprisonment, followed by a 2022 pardon. A separate 2015-merger/accounting case ended in final acquittal in 2025; the cases are distinct.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, 2026. This is not a live news archive.
